name: interocitor-monorepo
description: Umbrella monorepo for Interocitor packages, runtimes, examples, and future platform ports.

scripts.build:all: yarn workspace interocitor build && yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude interocitor -p run check
scripts.demo:todo: yarn workspace interocitor build && yarn demo:todo:server
scripts.test:e2e:cloudflare: yarn workspace interocitor build && playwright test -c examples/todo-cloudflare-do/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:cloudflare:run: yarn workspace interocitor build && RUN_CF_EXAMPLE_TESTS=1 playwright test -c examples/todo-cloudflare-do/playwright.config.ts
